description: This file is a shell script responsible for telemetry data upload to a server, handling retries, different connection methods (direct and Codebig), and managing related configurations and state files. It includes functions for network communication, endpoint configuration, and error handling.

methods.name: getTelemetryEndpoint
methods.description: Retrieves the telemetry upload endpoint URL, either from RFC feature settings or from the dcmresponse file.

methods.name: pidCleanup
methods.description: Removes the PID lock file to allow subsequent script runs.

methods.name: IsDirectBlocked
methods.description: Checks whether direct connection is blocked; currently always returns false.

methods.name: get_Codebigconfig
methods.description: Configures Codebig connection availability and preferences based on device settings.

methods.name: useDirectRequest
methods.description: Attempts to upload telemetry data via direct methods (HTTP or TFTP).

methods.name: useCodebigRequest
methods.description: Attempts to upload telemetry data via Codebig (cloud-based) methods.

methods.name: getErouterIpv4
methods.description: Retrieves the IPv4 address of the erouter device.

methods.name: getErouterIpv6
methods.description: Retrieves the IPv6 address of the erouter device.
